commands: git -C <work tree> diff origin/fast-track origin/hold/argon-blind-read-7-frames -- MyTradingSys/research
done_when: Each of the four defects is fixed with a verifiable check; headline numbers are recomputed from FORMULAS.md independently; the TRIALS row matches the results; reference base is verified or labelled UNVERIFIED; work is shipped via sync.py ship as a new commit with empty git cherry origin/fast-track <sha>.
goal: Fix the four defects that keep Argon (origin/hold/argon-blind-read-7-frames) off trunk, then re-land it as a new commit. Defects: (1) headline numbers stated more strongly than the data supports; (2) an invented-field count that does not match the actual fields; (3) a stale TRIALS row; (4) an unverified reference base.
scope_out: Live tree, HALT, deploys, mainnet, account data, .secrets; no merge of the hold branch as-is
steps: Read the hold branch diff and the four defects
Fix each defect with a check
Recompute headline numbers from FORMULAS.md, independently
Ship as a new commit via sync.py ship
tests: Each defect fix has a check that fails on the hold branch content and passes after the fix; numbers recomputed from FORMULAS.md, not from existing code.
title: argon-fix-defects-and-re-land
